gates.title: Readiness, concurrent waiters, loss accounting, fault handling, and cleanup reliability pass
The sync runtime receives during blocking actions and releases normal lifecycle resources
Credentials and payload redaction fixtures do not leak into built-in safe artifacts
Explicit Allure reporting preserves outcomes and independent test contexts
Candidate wheel and sdist install cleanly and Core imports without extras
Typing marker, public signatures, and installed documentation examples are verified
Dependency minima and the actual tested matrix contain no untested support claims
Queues and pending work remain bounded and memory/resource caps are verified
Tag, version, and changelog agree and archives contain no secrets or private artifacts
Owner identity, name, license, publishing rights, publisher, and environment are resolved
Publishing uses verified distributions from the same run and candidate with matching hashes
Mandatory failures, unexpected skips, flaky cases, and release stubs are not hidden
